question: ______ was established in 1948 with 23 countries as a global trade organisation to administer all multilateral trade agreements.

options.text: General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade

solution:
The correct answer is __**General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade.**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• After** World War II, 23 nations** signed the **General Agreement on Tariffs and Trade (GATT), **which went into effect on** January 1, 1948.**
 
• The GATT was established to** facilitate global trade.**
 
• Between **April 1947 and December 1993,** the GATT held **eight rounds**, each of which had notable accomplishments and results.
 
• In** 1995,** the GATT was absorbed into the **World Trade Organization (WTO),** which extended it.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **World Trade Organization:**

 
 
• The World Trade Organization (WTO) regulates **international trade laws and settles disputes**.
 
• In** 1995,** it was created.
 
 
 
• **International Reciprocal Trade Association:**
 
 
• The** Modern Trade and Barter Sector** is a sector that IRTA is devoted to **advancing reasonable and equitable standards **of conduct and operation.
 
 
 
• **World Chamber of Commerce:**
 
 
• **An international non-profit organization** called the International Chamber of Commerce promotes **collaboration in trade, culture, and humanitarian endeavor**s.
 
• The Global Chamber coordinates** projects and gatherings** aimed at advancing these objectives.
